verdict.rationale: CrewAI automations are defined as code and YAML config, and the docs say the YAML configuration lets you 'version control your agent settings', so external git-based versioning is implied. There is no first-party evidence of reviewing changes or rolling back automations or deployments, including in the AMP managed platform or Crew Studio. Missing for 10: native version history for crews/flows, built-in review/diff workflow, documented rollback of deployed automations, independent corroboration.
